entry.title: Trash and recycling: the enterprise fund: Finance Committee, 2026-03-26
entry.summary: Enterprise funds (solid waste, water, PEG). Town manager described enterprise fund appropriations, noting the water enterprise remains underbudgeted historically and will take years to repay the general fund.

entry.summary: Solid Waste Disposal Program Enterprise Fund. A standing warrant article authorizing funding of the solid waste enterprise program.

entry.summary: DPW budget: drainage, catch basin cleaning/street sweeping for stormwater compliance, recycling program cut, snow and ice
